title: RentBuild | C4 Components — Vue Web Application
note: ACTUAL SOURCE STRUCTURE AT 7e862dd; CLIENT CHECKS DO NOT ESTABLISH SERVER AUTHORIZATION

nodes.title: App.vue, router and context views
nodes.body:
[Component: Vue 3 / JavaScript / Vue Router / PrimeVue 4]
Routed forms and lists, session guards, language selection and app footer.

nodes.title: IAM — IamStore / IamApi
nodes.body:
[Component: JavaScript / Pinia / RxJS]
Sign-in/up commands, demo session and sign-out. SIGN_IN_PORT selects the adapter.

nodes.title: Profiles — ProfilesStore / ProfilesApi
nodes.body:
[Component: JavaScript / Pinia / RxJS]
CompanyProfile, Address and own-profile read/update workflow.

nodes.title: Subscriptions — SubscriptionsStore
nodes.body:
[Component: JavaScript / Pinia / RxJS]
Plans, UserSubscription, valid periods and SubscriptionsApi.

nodes.title: Inventory — InventoryStore / InventoryApi
nodes.body:
[Component: JavaScript / Pinia / RxJS]
Equipment, category, RentalRate and embedded AvailabilityBlock; catalogue and ownership workflows.

nodes.title: Rentals — RentalsStore / RentalsApi
nodes.body:
[Component: JavaScript / Pinia / RxJS]
RentalRequest, Rental, Delivery, EquipmentReturn; availability/participant/access ACL ports.

nodes.title: Maintenance — MaintenanceStore / IncidentStore
nodes.body:
[Component: JavaScript / Pinia / RxJS]
Maintenance and Incident workflows; equipment-condition and rental-activity ACL ports.

nodes.title: app.services.js / services.js
nodes.body:
[Component: JavaScript / Pinia]
configureServices registers ACL providers; resolve / registerStore / exposeStore connect owned models to Pinia state.

nodes.title: HttpClient and owned API endpoints
nodes.body:
[Component: JavaScript / Axios / RxJS]
Axios requests exposed as Observable; AbortController cancellation. Assemblers map transport resources to models.

nodes.title: Demo API
nodes.body:
[External to this scope: Node.js / json-server]
TB1 JSON resources and illustrative authentication; not authoritative production rules.

R1 | shell -> iam | Sign-in/up views invoke actions
R2 | shell -> profiles | Profile views invoke actions
R3 | shell -> subscriptions | Plans view invokes actions
R4 | shell -> inventory | Equipment views invoke actions
R5 | shell -> rentals | Request/rental views invoke actions
R6 | shell -> maintenance | Condition views invoke actions
R7 | composition -> rentals | Registers Inventory / Profiles / IAM / Subscriptions / Maintenance ACL ports
R8 | composition -> inventory | Registers access and request ports
R9 | composition -> maintenance | Registers access, equipment and rental activity ports

R11 | http -> mock | Sends requests [HTTP/HTTPS + JSON]
